in_marathi.name: Anuja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'anuja' which means 'leader' or 'graceful one'. In Hindu mythology, Anuja is a name of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Anuja
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Graceful, pleasing
